name: Maiko Yuzuki
source:
A voice actress from a very young age, you've definitely heard Maiko's voice somewhere. Her most predominant role is on the children's girl show Melody Pretty role that she holds particularly close to heart. She spends most of her time when she's not working online roleplaying on Melody Pretty forums and generally watching anime,

Something of a shut in (To the point we had to kidnap her in her own house because she WOULDN'T LEAVE IT) the prison has been a bit of a shock to her, especially, interacting with the other prisoners, She's generally friendly and sweet but can be extremely awkward at points, not as used to face to face interaction as she once was, But she seems to be well intentioned, just chronically online.

When we interrogated her she wouldn't stop crying, she was sobbing profusely and I would have felt bad if she wasn't a fully grown woman.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Maiko_Yuzuki_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
